    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_generic_localization_family (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (hn : ¬IsEFinite R) :
    let F := AlgebraicClosure k; let A := ExtendedAlgebra k F R; ∃ (P : TwoTerm R) (B : Type u) (x : Ring B) (x_1 : Algebra k B) (f : R →ₐ[k] B), IsUniversalLocalization (fun (x : Unit) => P) f.toRingHom ∧ ∃ (d : ℕ) (_ : 0 < d) (K : Type u) (x_3 : Field K) (q : B →+* Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) K) (S : Set (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat A))), S.Infinite ∧ Submodule.span K (Set.range ⇑q) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ (a b : B), q a ≠ 0 → q b ≠ 0 → ∃ (z : B), q (a * z * b) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ (x_4 : ↑S), ∃ (M : FGModuleCat A) (v : Module.Basis (Fin d) F ↑M.obj) (ρ : B →ₐ[k] Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) F), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = ↑x_4 ∧ (∀ (r : R), ρ (f r) = (basedAction v) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧ Submodule.span F (Set.range ⇑ρ) = ⊤ ∧ ∃ (π : ↥q.range →ₐ[k] Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) F), ∀ (a : B), π (q.rangeRestrict a) = ρ a

    A missing projective class yields a prime matrix image of one ground localization. Its relations hold on infinitely many nonisomorphic geometric modules of a single dimension.
